page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 28 physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution, such as stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression, falls into the weak to poor categories, reflecting the older Broadwell architecture. However, the high core count enables average multi-core performance across stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations also perform within the average tier.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is its reliance on older CPU architecture, which limits single-threaded efficiency but offers a high density of dedicated physical cores. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this profile is suitable for workloads that scale horizontally or require high parallelization rather than raw single-core speed. Recommended workloads include multi-threaded applications, static web serving, intermediate database operations, software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224.0 GB of RAM, running on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio but lacks local storage and GPU acceleration. Performance benchmarks reveal a contrast between weak single-core execution and average multi-core capabilities, with memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput also landing in the average tier. The instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Given its high core count and balanced memory allocation, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is best suited for multi-threaded workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that do not require high single-threaded performance or local NVMe storage.
